operations.name: cf_graph_profile
operations.title: Rooted graph profile
operations.description: Bind the complete six-vertex simple graph, sink, edges, degrees and connectivity.

operations.name: cf_laplacian
operations.title: Full Laplacian certificate
operations.description: Return the exact symmetric integer Laplacian and its zero row sums.

operations.name: cf_reduced_laplacian
operations.title: Reduced Laplacian certificate
operations.description: Delete the sink row and column and bind the exact nonsingular five-by-five matrix.

operations.name: cf_tree_count
operations.title: Matrix-tree determinant
operations.description: Compute the exact reduced-Laplacian determinant and finite spanning-tree count.

operations.name: cf_invariant_factors
operations.title: Critical-group invariant factors
operations.description: Derive determinantal divisors and invariant factors from every bounded minor.

operations.name: cf_stabilization
operations.title: Sink stabilization certificate
operations.description: Stabilize the declared nonnegative chip configuration and retain its odometer.

operations.name: cf_odometer_balance
operations.title: Odometer balance identity
operations.description: Check the exact initial, final, reduced-Laplacian and sink-loss balance.

operations.name: cf_abelian_order
operations.title: Abelian order comparison
operations.description: Compare smallest- and largest-index legal firing orders without promoting the model to a real process.

operations.name: cf_avalanche_trace
operations.title: Bounded addition trace
operations.description: Add one chip to the maximal stable configuration and retain the declared legal trace.

operations.name: cf_stable_enumeration
operations.title: Stable configuration census
operations.description: Enumerate every bounded stable nonsink vector and bind its deterministic digest.

operations.name: cf_burning_test
operations.title: Dhar burning certificate
operations.description: Apply the exact sink-edge burning vector to the maximal stable configuration.

operations.name: cf_recurrent_census
operations.title: Recurrent configuration census
operations.description: Enumerate stable configurations that pass the exact burning test.

operations.name: cf_parking_census
operations.title: Graph-parking-function census
operations.description: Enumerate bounded parking functions using every nonempty nonsink subset.

operations.name: cf_superstable_duality
operations.title: Recurrent-superstable duality
operations.description: Compare complements of recurrent configurations with the complete parking-function set.

operations.name: cf_equivalence_class
operations.title: Unique recurrent class representative
operations.description: Find the unique recurrent representative of the declared stable query using exact Laplacian equivalence.

operations.name: cf_addition_action
operations.title: Recurrent addition action
operations.description: Add at the declared vertex, stabilize and retain recurrence closure.

operations.name: cf_spanning_tree_enumeration
operations.title: Direct spanning-tree enumeration
operations.description: Enumerate all five-edge spanning trees and compare their count with the determinant.

operations.name: cf_explanation
operations.title: Accessible finite explanation
operations.description: Represent the finite graph invariants while reserving human and assistive-technology evaluation.

operations.name: cf_observation_gap
operations.title: Real-domain observation reservation
operations.description: Keep missing measurements, participants, calibration and independent review explicit.

operations.name: cf_authority_gate
operations.title: Consequential authority reservation
operations.description: Keep all real consequential actions held for competent and affected authority.
